plan: v6: nod in 4 directions, dash in 8 directions (user decision 2026-10-19)
written_before: ES of any seed, and before any controller touches the blind set

nod.goal: tilt toward phi >= 30 deg (projection of derocked roll/pitch) held 0.1 s, then total tilt < 5 deg

dash.goal: travel 0.15 m along phi and stop (|v_along| < 0.1 m/s for 0.3 s)

direction_convention: phi in the heading frame at T0: 0 forward, 90 left; attitude (roll, pitch) = A*(-sin phi, cos phi) (signs.json)
controller: round-5 architecture; inputs 25 (8 direction-command channels); outputs up/down pulses + 2 graded units (roll, pitch set-points); 2564 parameters; gate + 1 s tail, righting reflex 25 deg, refractory 37 ms

opponent.description: 2-D set-point schedule on reflex PID + law_tuned pulse law, tuned per task and direction class on the pilot grid (16 tune cases, 2 per direction)

training.imitation: 40 epochs, BCE(pos weight 3) + 5 ref MSE on both set-points, best val epoch
training.es: OpenAI-ES pop 32, sigma 0.03, Adam 0.02, 60 generations, 8 nod + 8 dash fresh cases per generation, objective = (2/3, 1/3) weighted mean over tasks of (case score / normaliser of its class) + 0.3 per deg of true tilt peak above 60
training.prefix_cache: shared pre-command prefix (cache8.py), verified bit-identical to the full simulation

selection: every 5th-generation centre (13) on 64 nod + 64 dash validation cases (offset 60_000); eligible: 0 crashes and true tilt peak < 70 deg on all; lowest objective
ratio: task ratio = mean over cases of learned score / opponent median score of the case direction class on the blind set; manoeuvre mean = (nod + dash)/2

primary_M2.per_seed: manoeuvre mean <= 0.95 AND 0 learned crashes on the 64 blind manoeuvre episodes
primary_M2.hover_upset: not re-run: the learned layer never takes charge without a command (gate), so hover = 1.000 and upset = 1.050 by construction, as in M1

secondary: per direction class ratios and paired wins (nod: pitch, roll; dash: pitch, roll, diag)
crashes of the opponent on the blind set
predictions_written_before_results: dash pitch and diag classes: learned ratio < 1 (classical never settles there; pulses act on pitch)
dash roll class: learned ~ classical (classical already settles quickly; pulses give no roll torque)
nod roll class: no pulse advantage expected; any gain comes from the set-point unit only

amendment_1.written: 2026-10-19, before any selection or blind-set run; ES of seed 4 at generation ~5 on CloudPC-2, no other seed started
amendment_1.machine_rule: ES search may run on any machine; centre selection (reselect) and the blind-set evaluation of every seed run only on CloudPC-2 (the machine whose baseline/normalisers are in baseline.json). Same rule as plan v4 rounds 3-6.
amendment_1.reason: GoogleCloud (Ubuntu 26.04, g++ 15.2, Zen 3) reproduces the self-tests but not the reference episode bit for bit (score 1.279100774155 / 43 pulses vs 1.288582208870 / 42 on CloudPC-2: Ubuntu 24.04, g++ 13.3, glibc 2.39, Zen 5); the dynamics amplify last-bit floating-point differences of the toolchain. Search on such a machine is a valid but differently-rounded simulator; selection and the test are therefore confined to one machine.
